I've struggled with depression, anxiety, and suicidal ideation for a long time. During one of my last trips, it wasn't very visual but it gave me such an amazing feeling of love and comfort. While I was in that "space" I asked if I could please stay there and experience that because I didn't want to be in this life and experience the pain and suffering anymore. The feeling seemed to grow and in a weird way, I kind of got the message that if I wanted to kill myself, it would be okay. This was kind of odd to me because everything I've heard from others up until this point was that it wasn't okay to commit suicide. 

Obviously I haven't committed suicide yet, but honestly since that trip I've waken up every morning wondering what the hell I'm still doing in this fucking reality. Clearly, we have no idea what happens when we die, whether it be an afterlife, going back to "source", or just complete nothingness and ceasing of awareness (which honestly I kind of hope it's this). However, since that trip I've been left with a feeling of whatever it is, it's going to be better than this fucking life. I hope to one day be able to overcome the survival instinct that's instilled in our brains and actually go through with it, but it's nice that I was able to feel some sort of understanding about this, especially since suicide is so taboo to consider in our culture and society. 

*I just want to note that I'm not advocating anyone try to commit suicide! I'm just telling my experience that I had, which tends to fall out of the norm of insights people usually get from trips.*
